The petitioner is driver of the seized pick-up van and he was doing his work for his livelihood on monthly salary.
Nothing has been recovered from the conscious possession of the petitioner.
The petitioner is languishing in custody since 23.11.2022.
A statement has been made in para 3 of the petition that petitioner has no criminal antecedent.

Considering the facts aforesaid and the period under custody, let the petitioner, above named, be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 10,000/- (Ten Thousands) with two sureties of the like amount Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.20410 of 2023(2) dt.22-05-2023 each to the satisfaction of learned Additional Sessions Judge, East Champaran, Motihari in connection with Chakiya P.S. Case No. 506 of 2022.
